{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float after removing commas
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
test_orders = data[data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Internal test orders (n={len(test_orders)}): {test_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue', 'revenue_clean']]}\n")

# Filter for completed orders and exclude test orders
total_revenue = data[(data['status'] == 'completed') & (data['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the final result
total_revenue"}
